_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard for AUGMENTS carrying the folded `Speed` affix. Keyed by augment name, not wiki title: augments have no item page and every augment record shares one `Augment Slot` url, so the item shard's title join cannot reach them. Values are verbatim from `Raw data/Item augments`; `provenance` records whether the wiki stated the value or a template default filled it in. Only `stated` is solver-eligible.

Sapphire of Snowpeaks Speed.note: Name says Speed; the cell renders Striding. Classification follows the template, never the augment name.

Topaz of Swiftness 5%.note: Melee Alacrity 5 arrives separately from upstream and is never shadowed. Striding grants no ranged component.

Topaz of Swiftness 10%.note: Melee Alacrity 10 arrives separately from upstream and is never shadowed. Striding grants no ranged component.

Topaz of Swiftness 15%.tooltip: Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Topaz of Swiftness 15%.note: The only augment using the Speed template. 30 is a recorded switch row (30 -> 15), so the attack-speed magnitude is stated, not defaulted. Unqualified 'attack speed' means both melee and ranged.
